title: Cyberleek Ransomware Group: Victims, Leak Site, TTPs & IOCs
description: CyberLeek is a newly emerged extortionist and data leakage group that employs a novel monetization strategy based on public engagement rather than traditional ransom demands. The group gained attention for leaking proprietary content from Rockstar Games and primarily targets major software publishers in the gaming industry. They utilize a Solana-based cryptocurrency token called $CYBERLEEK to drive audience engagement and funding. Their operations combine elements of hacktivism with financial motivations centered on cryptocurrency profits. The group stages data exfiltration from internal development environments using compromised credentials, publicly releases gameplay footage, and conducts decentralized voting to determine which content to leak next. They communicate through unconventional channels like Telegram to facilitate interactions with their audience.
